SLIID is the professional body representing, connecting and supporting interior designers across Sri Lanka.

People · Spaces · A Better Sri Lanka

01 · Who we are

The National Professional Body for Interior Designers.

The Sri Lanka Institute of Interior Designers (SLIID) was established under Act of Parliament No. 2 of 1998.

We promote professional excellence, ethical practice and the value of interior design in creating better places for people to live, work and experience.

Our history

A Journey of Progress

From a shared vision in 1998 to a growing community today, SLIID has been at the forefront of shaping interior design in Sri Lanka.
